question: What speech restriction applies when ritual substances are unavailable?
premises: The prior verse states substances may be unavailable.
Declaring this sipping is explicitly prohibited.
inference: Therefore even in that case one must not speak of this sipping.
uncertainties: The ritual nuance of 'ācamanaṃ' in this context may be technical.
plain_english: Even so, O auspicious one, this sipping must not be spoken of.
